beginner.summary: For developers, build engineers and DevOps newcomers who must run or contribute to builds on Atlassian Bamboo Data Center. Covers the server, Bamboo home and first login, projects, plans, stages, jobs and tasks, linking Git and Bitbucket repositories, script, Maven and npm tasks, test result parsing, triggers, variables, artifacts, local and remote agents, capabilities and requirements, plan branches, build results and notifications, deployment projects, environments and releases, Jira and Bitbucket links, basic permissions and Docker tasks, ending with a build-and-deploy capstone configured through the Bamboo UI.
prerequisites: Uses Git from the command line: clone, branch, commit, push and open a pull request
Can build a Java project with Maven or a JavaScript project with npm on a laptop and read the console output
Has a training Bamboo Data Center instance (or a laptop with a supported JDK, 8 GB RAM and Docker) plus a Bitbucket or GitHub account for sample repositories
outcomes: Create Bamboo projects and plans with stages, jobs and tasks that check out, build and test code from a linked repository
Configure triggers, variables, artifacts, plan branches and job requirements so builds run on the right agent at the right time
Set up a deployment project with environments and releases that deploys a plan artifact to test and staging targets
Read build logs and test results, connect builds to Jira issues and Bitbucket commits, and grant users the plan permissions they need

intermediate.summary: For build engineers and DevOps practitioners who already run Bamboo plans through the UI and now need to manage them as code at team scale. Covers Bamboo Specs in Java and YAML, repository-stored Specs, Specs permissions and scanning, exporting plans to Specs, branch merging with Branch Updater and Gatekeeper, pull request builds, plan dependencies, shared credentials and Specs encryption, deployment projects in Specs, release promotion rules, remote agents as services, dedicated agents, Elastic Bamboo on EC2, artifact handlers and build expiry, splitting tests across jobs, the REST API with personal access tokens, deeper Jira integration, global and project permissions and build troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has completed the beginner level or has built and deployed with Bamboo plans, artifacts, variables and deployment projects through the UI
Reads and writes YAML and basic Java and can run Maven builds locally
Has project admin rights on a training Bamboo Data Center instance, a Bitbucket or GitHub repository and, for the elastic agent day, an AWS sandbox account
outcomes: Define plans, plan permissions and deployment projects as Bamboo Specs in Java or YAML and store them in repositories with controlled access
Design branch workflows with plan branches, pull request builds, Branch Updater, Gatekeeper and plan dependencies
Operate agent pools with remote agents as services, dedicated agents and Elastic Bamboo, and manage artifact storage and build expiry
Automate Bamboo with the REST API and personal access tokens, secure credentials, and troubleshoot failed builds and queues from logs and agent data
